_doc: Declared-intent ledger for runWarnCheck advisory gates (E4 ceremony detector, M15b #1943). Every runWarnCheck call site in scripts/check-all.mjs MUST have an entry here: either a dated promotion (promoteBy) or permanent:true with rationale. This is the dated-debt discipline of suppressions expiry (INV-31) applied to the gate roster itself — an advisory gate with no dated promotion is ceremony ('advisory-forever'). The ceremony detector that enforces this ledger is deferred (sub-issue of #1943 — owner decision on the 2 pre-existing runWarnCheck gates 'orchestrator coverage (#1410)' and 'conformance' is OD-14); until it lands this file is declared-intent, unenforced-for-now. Entries below are the 4 new advisory enforcers landed in #1943.

entries.rationale: M8 core substrate + M12 citation enforcement. Advisory until the dispatch cross-check sidecar is routinely populated; promote to runCheck + --enforce at gated-review once producer lines land in ship.md.
M13 refutation-by-majority. Advisory until the refutation skill is exercised on real audit findings; promote at gated-review for Standard-tier audits.
M14 dry-pass termination. Advisory until the codebase-audit skill writes the pass-ledger; promote at gated-review where the ledger is part of the audited evidence bundle.
M1 handoff-lint. Advisory at land-time (M1 is a cost rule, all tiers); promote to runCheck once the producer side (/ship handoff phase) references --file mode.
